sloka: यस्माद् विप्रेन्द्रम् अद्राक्षम् सुप्रभाता निशा मम ।पूर्वम् राजर्षि शब्देन तपसा द्योतित प्रभः ॥१-१८-५४॥
transliteration: yasmād viprendram adrākṣam suprabhātā niśā mama ।pūrvam rājarṣi śabdena tapasā dyotita prabhaḥ ॥1-18-54॥

translations.english: O Brahman your arrival has caused surprise to me. It has conferred great purity on me. O Lord by your very presence here, I feel I haved acquired the merits of a pilgrimage.
